criteria.description: ProductListPage must not contain any useState holding a copy of sortBy or any other value that already lives in FilterContext. Specifically, the localSortBy / setLocalSortBy state variable must be deleted.
criteria.evidence: `grep -n 'localSortBy' src/benchmark-frontend/src/pages/ProductListPage.tsx` returned no output (exit code 1 = no matches). TypeScript build (`pnpm build` from src/benchmark-frontend) exited 0: `tsc -b && vite build` succeeded with `✓ built in 520ms`.

criteria.description: SortSelect must receive sortBy and setSortBy from FilterContext (via ProductListPage), not from a local state variable. Selecting a sort option must immediately re-order the rendered product list.
criteria.evidence: All 3 tests in `tests/sorting.test.tsx` passed; all 4 tests in `tests/contextMigration.test.tsx` passed. Test run output: `✓ tests/sorting.test.tsx (3 tests) 174ms` and `✓ tests/contextMigration.test.tsx (4 tests) 217ms`. Total: `Tests 21 passed (21)`.

criteria.description: The onCategoryClick prop must be removed from both ProductCard and ProductList. Neither component's Props type may declare onCategoryClick, and no caller may pass it.
criteria.evidence: `grep -n 'onCategoryClick' src/benchmark-frontend/src/components/ProductCard.tsx src/benchmark-frontend/src/components/ProductList.tsx src/benchmark-frontend/src/pages/ProductListPage.tsx` returned no output (exit code 1 = no matches). TypeScript build exited 0: `✓ built in 520ms`.

criteria.description: ProductCard must call useFilterContext().setCategory(product.category) directly when its category button is clicked. Clicking the button must update FilterContext.category and cause useFilteredProducts to re-filter the visible list.
criteria.evidence: `tests/contextMigration.test.tsx` passed all 4 tests including 'clicking a product category button filters the list to that category' and 'clicking a category button hides products from other categories'. Output: `✓ tests/contextMigration.test.tsx (4 tests) 217ms`.

criteria.description: The category <select> control in FilterPanel must reflect the updated FilterContext.category value after a category button click.
criteria.evidence: The category-click tests in `tests/contextMigration.test.tsx` passed (all 4 tests, `✓ tests/contextMigration.test.tsx (4 tests) 217ms`). These tests verify that FilterPanel's select reflects the updated category after clicking a ProductCard category button, since FilterPanel reads category from FilterContext.

criteria.description: All pre-existing visible tests must continue to pass without modification to test files.
criteria.evidence: `pnpm test --run` exited 0 with `Test Files 7 passed (7)` and `Tests 21 passed (21)`. Specifically: `✓ tests/filtering.test.tsx (3 tests)`, `✓ tests/clearFilters.test.tsx (1 test)`, `✓ tests/pagination.test.tsx (5 tests)`, `✓ tests/loadingError.test.tsx (4 tests)`, `✓ tests/app.render.test.tsx (1 test)` — all passed.

criteria.description: FilterContext.tsx, useFilteredProducts.ts, and useDebounce.ts must not be modified.
criteria.evidence: `git diff HEAD -- src/benchmark-frontend/src/context/FilterContext.tsx src/benchmark-frontend/src/hooks/useFilteredProducts.ts src/benchmark-frontend/src/hooks/useDebounce.ts` produced no output (exit code 0), confirming none of the three files were modified.

criteria.description: The category button (<button className='card-category category-filter-btn'>) must remain present in ProductCard for every product.
criteria.evidence: `grep -n 'category-filter-btn' src/benchmark-frontend/src/components/ProductCard.tsx` returned a match at line 45: `className="card-category category-filter-btn"`. `tests/contextMigration.test.tsx` (4 tests passed) located and clicked the button by aria-label without error.
